result.summary: Found 1 issue: a broken placeholder image in a restaurant card, indicating failed content loading and a visual inconsistency with the rest of the interface.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a generic broken image icon (crossed-out image symbol) instead of a proper restaurant or food photo, which breaks the visual consistency of the list and indicates missing/failed image content.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct restaurant imagery for this card, and implement a branded, design-consistent fallback placeholder to display if the image fails to load, instead of the default broken image icon.
